title:
Epic to remove all filters applied to a {@link UiSdlDataGrid} passed through action's payload.
It cleans the related {@link UiSdlFilterPanel} and reloads the grid to show all the {@link ReliabilityAsset}s
and finally opens the modal with id = `modalId`.

Payload required fields:
 - `gridId`: Target grid.
 - `filterPanelId`: Filter panel that performed the filtering (to clear its fields).
 - `modalId`: Modal to open that contains the target grid.
name: AssetGridRemoveFiltersEpic
